data.script: Oliver: Hello? Ingrid? I can't come to practice today. … Oliver: I've got a terrible cold and a cough. … Oliver: My mum took my temperature — it's thirty-eight degrees! … Oliver: The doctor says I should stay in bed for two days. … Oliver: Kili has just brought my medicine from the chemist's. Thanks, Kili! … Oliver: Don't worry — I'll be fine for the concert on Friday. I've already practised the new song a hundred times!
